subject: 1600WP (January 2010) attachment sheet, page 1, the Schedule 1.1 header row 'WITHHOLDING AGENT TIN:', fourth (branch-code) group of that TIN comb chain: the printed box x 366.48-401.284, y 465.96-479.76 pt (top-left origin) in the pinned source '1600WP p1ENCS.pdf' sha256 6ea2ef0f6c84a68ef1c50ad63f4ff0e95a68258f52b62b98f305c861c8b75d55. BIR has NO field key for it: the harvested frm1600WP:txtBranchCode is item 5 on the form itself (p1c16, corrected by C05), not this attachment header. The cell id p1c74 is a HINT only: cell ids are quantised bounding boxes and renumber on any geometry change, so the printed box is what identifies the subject and the edit anchor below is what binds it to a batch. This record touches p1c74 and nothing else -- not p1c16, and not the three neighbouring groups p1c68 / p1c70 / p1c72, which this batch emits as data-field-kind="text" rather than combs.
what: The branch-code comb carries five compartments instead of four, inside the SAME emitted box. Nothing is widened, moved or repainted: the box stays 34.89 x 13.94pt at 366.4,465.96, the writing surface stays top 0.25pt / height 13.44pt, each input keeps class "fi fh11 fc", and the five compartments divide the box equally -- left(i) = round(i * 34.89 / 5, 2) giving 0 / 6.98 / 13.96 / 20.93 / 27.91pt and widths 6.98 / 6.98 / 6.97 / 6.98 / 6.98pt, which sum to exactly 34.89pt. Each compartment carries one text input, maxlength 1, sharing the group's field name, slot indexes 0..4 contiguous. Declared pitch attribute 6.98 (nominal 34.89/5 = 6.978). The equal division absorbs the horizontal insets the 4-slot emission carried (first slot left 0.21pt, last slot ending 0.13pt short of the box's right edge) and, unavoidably, stops aligning with the printed ticks: today's four slots land on them to within 0.011pt, and five compartments cannot land on four printed cells. That is the visible cost of the change, not a side effect to hide.
reason: BIR's January-2010 artwork for the 1600WP attachment sheet is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. Measured from the pinned PDF, the agent-TIN branch box prints exactly three internal ticks, at x 375.79, 384.61 and 393.44, each 0.25pt wide at the foot of the box -- four compartments -- and prints no ink inside them at all (no glyph and no vector outline lies within the box). The chain around it prints 3+3+3+4: three groups of three compartments at 257.16-284.121, 293.44-320.891 and 330.20-357.651, separated by grey (DeviceGray 0.753) filled boxes. A Philippine TIN is 3-3-3-5, so four compartments cannot carry the branch code, and no rule can derive 'the branch code is five characters' from 2010 ink -- which is exactly why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug. The stage-1 emission is not wrong about the artwork: its four slots reproduce the four printed compartments to 0.011pt. Filing safety: this header is what binds a page of the alphabetical list of payees to the withholding agent that withheld from them. An agent whose branch code is five characters cannot enter it here at all, so the schedule page is filed under a truncated branch code or under none. Corpus context, measured from the pinned PDFs on 2026-08-08: of 53 bundles, 39 print 3+3+3+5, three print 3+3+3+3, one prints 3+3+3+4 (1600WP 2010) and ten are not measurable by that method -- but that census reads one TIN chain per bundle and never saw this attachment-header chain, which is measured here for the first time and prints 3+3+3+4 as well.
authority: User rule of 2026-08-15 (the only valid Philippine TIN is 3-3-3-5); this agent-TIN branch tail has no harvested field_key in this checkout, regulation not identified in-repo. The change rests on that user rule, NOT on a harvested declaration: no field_key in this checkout names this comb at all. rules/forms/1600wp-v2010/fields.json declares frm1600WP:txtBranchCode with constraints.max_length = 5, item_number "5", page 1, confidence "high", source_refs ["official-hta-runtime#control:L464", "official-hta-runtime#saveXML:L2580-L2660", "revision-matched-encrypted-sample"], but that key is the PRIMARY item-5 branch code on the 1600WP form itself -- the printed box 218.52-276.00 at y 139.20-156.72, emitted as p1c16 and corrected separately by C05 -- and it does NOT name this attachment-header comb; it is quoted here only so a reviewer can see the check was made. frm1600WP:txtTIN1 / txtTIN2 / txtTIN3 (max_length 3 each, official-hta-runtime#control:L461 / L462 / L463) belong to that same item-5 chain. frm1600WP:CategoryAgent_P and CategoryAgent_G are item-7 radio/boolean category checkboxes, not TIN combs. frm1600WP:dtSched:txtTin1 through txtTin10 are the schedule's per-payee TIN fields on page 2, one 14-character text string each, not a compartmented branch comb and not this row's header. All 119 harvested fields were searched for 'tin', 'branch' and 'agent'; those sixteen keys are the whole result and none of them is this comb. NO BIR issuance is cited because none could be identified from anything in this checkout, and unlike C01 there is not even a harvested runtime declaration to lean on; both gaps are stated deliberately rather than filled with a plausible-looking regulation number or with C01's harvested-HTA sentence, which would be a fabricated citation here.
diverges_from: audit.py comb_slots_match_printed on this comb -- the corrected document emits five compartments where the pinned artwork prints four, and must keep being reported as an offender of that assertion (failure kind layout-printed-mismatch where the layout carries the change, invalid-emission where only the markup does). Stated exactly: this subject is ALREADY an offender of that check in the uncorrected batch, because audit.py's own printed_compartments recovers 2 compartments here, not 4 -- its candidate band is anchored on the box baseline at y 479.76 and three of the four printed ticks stop at y 479.19, 0.57pt short of it, so only the tick at x 393.44 is counted. The correction moves the emitted count 4 -> 5 against that same recovered 2; it does not create the offender and must not be reported as if it did. Second check: the comb_referee reviewed-structure pin EXPECTED_HTML_STRUCTURE_SHA256["1600wp-2010"] = ab1e006ade827451181a305fc064f95515dda96fcc4d07a50ee804eb3326e54c, which the corrected document will not match once it carries a fifth input; that pin must NOT be moved to accommodate this override. audit.py inputs_span_no_printed_divider is deliberately NOT claimed: computed with audit.py's own source_printed_dividers and its own DIVIDER_INTERIOR_PT = 0.5 / DIVIDER_MIN_Y_OVERLAP_PT = 1.0, the corrected five inputs span zero printed dividers, exactly as today's four do -- the four foot ticks are short strokes that source_printed_dividers does not report at all, and the box's own left and right rails at x 366.48 / 401.284 fall inside the interior margin. Claiming that check here would be a fabricated divergence. Neither of the two named checks may be allowlisted, excluded or waived to make this correction quiet, and no tolerance moves for it.
verified_by: An independent producer, sharing nothing with whatever writes the correction: the four printed compartments are re-derived from the pinned PDF by a reader that is not extract.py (re-derived while authoring this record by `mutool draw -F trace` and by Poppler `pdftocairo -svg`, both agreeing with PyMuPDF to 0.0012pt on the box 366.48-401.284 and on all three ticks 375.789 / 384.609 / 393.441), and the five emitted compartments are re-derived from the written bytes by a parser that reads none of emit.py's markers. Not from build/layout, not from the IR, not from the applier's own manifest, and not from a determinism re-run -- that runs the writer twice and both halves drift together. Note for whoever verifies: a first pass here reported ZERO ticks in this box from all three readers at once, because fitz.Rect.intersects() is false for the zero-width rect of a vertical line and because mutool and Poppler report y in PDF up-space. Any re-derivation must keep zero-area paths and must state which origin it is using.
